comment: Samples that do not decode today. They are reported as skipped, with the
reason, so this job turns red on a NEW break rather than being red from
the day it was created - and so the list cannot quietly rot: a sample
listed here that starts passing is reported as a failure too, which is
the signal to delete its entry.
Keyed by the tail of the sample URL.

known.mpeg1_short.mpg: pipeline ended without output (exit 1). The same MPEG-2 content decodes through the player (the Showcase mpeg2 demo passes), so this is the extension's route, not the codec. Not yet diagnosed.
known.mpeg2_audio.mpg: pipeline ended without output (exit 1) - same as mpeg1_short.mpg.
known.mpeg2_centaur.mpg: pipeline ended without output (exit 1) - same as mpeg1_short.mpg.
known.mpeg2_noaudio.m2v: pipeline ended without output (exit 1). A video-only MPEG-2 elementary stream also hits the known progressive-playback limitation documented in README.md, where no segment is ever emitted without an audio track.
